rows.name: W-4 · Run
rows.why: One screen for each level. A short header, the wait card, a small Next bar. The graph is on the left, one short row for each step run on the right, and a marker on the current step. Old passes fold into one row. A restart ↺ is a chip.

rows.name: W-5 · Step run sheet
rows.why: A tap on a row or a chip opens a sheet over the dimmed run page. It shows the action, the state, the time and the result, links to the actual input and output documents, and a link to the step definition. A waiting step has the act buttons.

rows.name: W-C1 · Run row
rows.why: One line shows a run on the session views: the workflow, the current step with its level path, a state dot, the elapsed time and a you marker. A tap opens the run page. The step bar is a try for hubs, restarts and levels.

sketches.caption: Try: step bar in the run row

rows.name: W-C2 · Wait card
rows.why: The card shows what a waiting run needs from you: the step, the question, how long it waits and the act buttons. It shows on the run page and on the owner session page. In the inbox it is a normal question card with an Open run link.
